item.title: Asset Management Services (AIMS)
item.description:
Management and Budget | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2027-01-20 In plain English (machine-written): The Office of Management and Budget is seeking proposals from architectural and engineering firms for one contract to provide asset management services on an as-needed basis, with responses due Jan. 20, 2027.

The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is seeking to award one (1) contract to an appropriately qualified architectural/engineering firm to provide Asset Management services on an as-needed basis.

item.title: CoStar Subscription
item.description:
Management and Budget | Public Comment on Contract Awards | Notice In plain English (machine-written): The Office of Management and Budget is seeking public comment on a proposed contract with CoStar Realty Information, Inc., for a subscription to its commercial real estate database, with a maximum value of $149,380.

This is a notice that the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.

 

Contract Type:  Contract

Contractor: CoStar Realty Information, Inc.            

Contractor Address: 1331 L Street NW, Washington, District of Columbia, 20005

Scope of Services: Subscription to CoStar Realty Information for access to their commercial real estate database to OMB at 255 Greenwich Street, New York, NY, 10007

Maximum Value: $149,380.00

item.title: S&P Subscription

This is a notice that the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.

 

Contract Type:  Contract

Contractor: S&P Global Market Intelligence, LLC.              

Contractor Address: 55 Water Street, New York, NY, 10041

Scope of Services: Subscription to S&P Global Market Intelligence for U.S. macroeconomic forecasting services, access to their U.S. macro model, and use of their database of economic data to OMB at 255 Greenwich Street, New York, NY, 10007

Maximum Value: $244,500.00
